title: 4 Proverbs About the Mouth a Godly Man Learns Before 25
caption:
4 Proverbs a godly man learns before 25.

Fewer words. Answer soft. Listen first. Hold it back. Every one is about the mouth, and every one is harder than it sounds.

Which one did you break this week?
